if (!requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("jsonlite is required to emit manuscript calculation values.")
}

find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(current, "pyproject.toml")) || file.exists(file.path(current, ".git"))) {
      return(current)
    }
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) {
      stop("Unable to locate repository root from working directory: ", start)
    }
    current <- parent
  }
}

repo_root <- find_repo_root()
values_output_dir <- file.path(
  repo_root,
  "generated",
  "cache",
  "manuscript-calculation-values"
)
dir.create(values_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

sample_av <- mySample$av
sample_bv <- mySample$sample$bv
n <- mySample$n
N <- nrow(inventoryData)
B <- sum(inventoryData$bv)
g <- sqrt(N * (N - n) / n)
t_value <- qt(0.975, df = n - 1)

sum_y <- sum(sample_av)
mean_y <- mean(sample_av)
sum_y2 <- sum(sample_av^2)
var_y <- var(sample_av)
mpu_estimate <- N * mean_y
mpu_precision <- g * t_value * sqrt(var_y)

sum_x <- sum(sample_bv)
mean_x <- mean(sample_bv)
sum_x2 <- sum(sample_bv^2)
sum_xy <- sum(sample_bv * sample_av)
var_x <- var(sample_bv)
cov_xy <- cov(sample_bv, sample_av)
cor_xy <- cor(sample_bv, sample_av)

b1 <- (sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) / n) / (sum_x2 - (sum_x^2) / n)
reg_estimate <- N * mean_y + b1 * (B - N * mean_x)
var_reg <- ((n - 1) / (n - 2)) * (var_y - 2 * b1 * cov_xy + b1^2 * var_x)
prec_reg <- g * t_value * sqrt(var_reg)
reg_lower <- reg_estimate - prec_reg
reg_upper <- reg_estimate + prec_reg
adj_factor <- sqrt(1 - cor_xy^2)
prec_mpu_adjusted <- (g * t_value * sqrt(var_y)) * sqrt((n - 1) / (n - 2)) * adj_factor

diff_values <- sample_bv - sample_av
sum_d <- sum(diff_values)
sum_d2 <- sum(diff_values^2)
var_diff <- (sum_d2 - (sum_d^2) / n) / (n - 1)
diff_estimate <- B - N * (sum_d / n)
prec_diff <- g * t_value * sqrt(var_diff)
diff_lower <- diff_estimate - prec_diff
diff_upper <- diff_estimate + prec_diff

q_ratio <- sum_y / sum_x
ratio_estimate <- B * q_ratio
var_ratio <- (sum_y2 - 2 * q_ratio * sum_xy + q_ratio^2 * sum_x2) / (n - 1)
prec_ratio <- g * t_value * sqrt(var_ratio)
ratio_lower <- ratio_estimate - prec_ratio
ratio_upper <- ratio_estimate + prec_ratio

    list(id = "aux.mpu.sum_squared_audit_values", role = "sum_squared_audit_values", raw = sum_y2, format = "integer", tolerance = 1e-6),
    list(id = "aux.mpu.audit_value_variance", role = "audit_value_variance", raw = var_y, format = "integer"),
    list(id = "aux.mpu.estimated_population_value", role = "estimated_population_value", raw = mpu_estimate, format = "integer")
  )
)

message("Wrote manuscript calculation values: ", values_output_path)
